style: 修理人は匿名。外見・年齢感・性別の描画・衣装は美術設定で、依頼人チセとは同定しない。仮面・署名・修理印・帳面を人物画へ固定しない。三人には集団名だけを表示する。

files.prompt_en:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent full-body character portrait for a Japanese fantasy adventure game
Scene/backdrop: fully transparent background, isolated figure only
Style/medium: finely drawn ink outlines, soft layered watercolor and opaque painted shading, restrained storybook fantasy illustration, warm natural skin tones and nuanced fabric folds
Primary request: an anonymous repairer at a mask repair table, calmly listening to several people discuss shared ownership. Standing with empty hands, one palm slightly open at waist level and the other relaxed, a thoughtful attentive expression.
Subject: an adult woman with dark brown hair threaded with a few silver strands and tied in a low bun, an open face with gentle lines, a muted plum long-sleeved work blouse, a plain ochre brown cloth apron reaching below the knees, slate grey trousers and practical dark brown ankle boots.
Composition/framing: vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas, entire standing figure and both hands visible, head in upper fifth with generous transparent margin above, narrow balanced silhouette within central 65 percent, feet fully inside canvas. Three-quarter front view, readable face at small display size.
Lighting/mood: soft even illumination, patient attention and care
Constraints: exactly one person, empty hands, transparent alpha around the entire silhouette. No other people, masks, tools, tables, chairs, papers, books, signatures, personal emblems, floor, background, lettering or watermark. Appearance and clothing are art direction only; do not invent a name, personal history or a shared identity with the client.
files.prompt_ja: 日本語ファンタジーADV用の透過全身人物画。繊細なインク線、水彩の重なりと不透明な塗りの柔らかな陰影による抑制した物語画。温かな肌色と細やかな布のしわ。仮面の修理台で、共有について相談する人々へ落ち着いて耳を傾ける匿名の修理人。空いた片方の手のひらを腰の高さでわずかに開き、もう片手は自然に休め、思慮深く相手を見る表情で立つ。少し銀の混じる暗い茶髪を低いお団子にまとめ、穏やかな表情のしわを持つ成人女性。くすんだ梅色の長袖作業上衣、膝下まで届く簡素な黄土茶色の布前掛け、石板灰色のズボン、実用的な暗い茶色の足首丈の靴。1024×1536の縦長画面に全身と両手を収め、頭を上部5分の1へ置き、上に透過余白を確保する。中央65％以内にまとまる輪郭、足先まで入る斜め前向きの構図。縮小時も顔が読み取れる。柔らかく均等な光、根気よく丁寧に相手へ向き合う様子。背景と輪郭の周囲を完全透過にする。人物は一人、手には物を持たせない。他の人物、仮面、道具、机、椅子、紙、帳面、署名、個人の紋章、床、背景、文字、透かしを入れない。外見と衣装は美術設定であり、氏名、経歴、依頼人との同一性を創作しない。
